# xFacts

> Family hub for nutrition labels for software, one per adoption question. AppFacts and FeatureFacts fit any app; ToolFacts fits tools (v0.1: MCP servers); ModelFacts, AgentFacts, and SkillFacts cover AI layers when present. x is a variable, not a social network.
> This hub does not host per-label schemas or exemplars. Go to each label domain.

## Labels

| Label | Layer | Question | Agent entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| AppFacts | Application | What is this app built from? | https://appfacts.dev/ |
| ModelFacts | Model | What does this model document about itself? | https://modelfacts.dev/llms.txt |
| ToolFacts | Tool | What does this tool touch when invoked? | https://toolfacts.dev/llms.txt |
| AgentFacts | Agent configuration | What may this configuration do? | https://agentfacts.dev/llms.txt |
| SkillFacts | Skill package | What will this skill teach an agent to do? | https://skillfacts.dev/llms.txt |
| FeatureFacts | Product capabilities | What can this product do? | https://featurefacts.dev/llms.txt |

## Panel

Derived tool-surface view. Not a label. Hub embed: https://xfacts.dev/#panel
Derived JSON (`mcp-tools-list`): https://xfacts.dev/examples/forgetrail-mcp.panel.json
Native JSON (`tool-facts` stopgap): https://xfacts.dev/examples/forgetrail-mcp.native.panel.json
Schema: https://xfacts.dev/schema/panel.schema.json
Viewer: https://xfacts.dev/v/ (`pn1.` fragment).
Missing facts are `undisclosed`. The hub does not re-fetch or run a live drift monitor.

## Dogfood

Catalyst Forge ships the labels on its own tools. AppFacts on the open-source shelf, ToolFacts on ForgeTrail / ollanet / DictaWhisper MCP, SkillFacts on published skill packages. Catalogs mark those rows `dogfood: true`.

## Shared rules

- YAML frontmatter is the sole source of truth. Markdown body is the human skim.
- Schema validation checks structure, not truth or safety.
- Prefer `undisclosed` over guessing. `undisclosed` records absence, not intent. ModelFacts qualitative ratings are assessments unless a method and source are attached.
- ForgeTrail `runAudit` returns a packaged audit prompt and does not scan the user workspace.
- Specs and schemas are CC0. Tooling is MIT.
- Provenance fields and proposals: https://github.com/Catalyst-Forge-LLC/x-facts/blob/main/specs/PROVENANCE.md
